name: EQUAL_SECOND_MOMENT_QUARTIC_PROFILE_SPLITTING

model.basis: Trusted designation names the Astra family; no router invocation using an unsupported Pro alias or synthetic model detection.

objective: Determine the first possible and first nonzero local difference of threshold levels for two fixed symmetric photon profiles with identical mu2; prove regularity boundaries and evaluate the quartic difference for an explicit positive absolutely continuous pair at four retained physical nodes.
mode: Bounded cloud theory and lightweight numerical research; convergence to one final scoped decision

definitions.profile: Fixed symmetric Borel probability measure on [-1,1], independent of delta,W,center and branch
definitions.delta: Nonnegative outer halfwidth bound in eV
definitions.mu2: integral z^2 dnu; both comparison profiles have the identical mu2
definitions.actual_variance_W: eV^2; held fixed in partial delta derivatives
definitions.same_level: F_nu(delta,W_nu(delta))=A=F(0,w); exact zero-level theorem conditional on an exact simple interior root
definitions.H4: p*k''''(e)+q*k''''(x), in s^-4 eV^-4, p is endpoint mass
definitions.quartic_difference_candidate: W_P4-W_uniform = D4*delta^4+o(delta^4); D4=-Delta_mu4*H4/(24*C) in eV^-2; nonzero requires Delta_mu4*H4 != 0

conventions.thermal_state: w in eV/H, distinct from threshold variance
conventions.source_numbers: Exact-real interpretation of source binary64 literals; stored J decimals fixed; Decimal80 arithmetic is not interval certification
conventions.constants: Keep c_light,hbar,kB conventions; do not silently select natural units
conventions.D_operator: D=E*d/dE with gas state and J held fixed

profiles.positivity_to_verify: h_p=35/16*(z^2-3/7)^2+2/7>0; continuous on support, endpoint jumps upon zero extension

inherited_premises: Original fixed-support moment envelope and common-profile mixture class only
k in C3 and inherited k''>0,k'''<0; no new whole-interval derivative-sign certification

PHYS30 spent execution budget is historical and is not reset
theory_obligations: Prove equal-mu2 C3 response and physical right-side root difference o(delta^3), not O(delta^4)
Prove uniform C4 expansion and first possible quartic transfer with moving centers/weights and actual variance retained
Distinguish generic nonzero quartic term from H4=0 degeneracy and no universal next-even-order claim
Give a sharp C3 counterexample and a positive AC equal-mu2 unequal-mu4 example
Derive source-real physical-kernel C4 or stronger regularity from the actual fixed formula
Derive both D^0..6 and ordinary energy Taylor formulas for k''''; no numerical value by renaming a lower-order cache
Treat same nonzero A through numerator N-AQ and show correct denominator N_W-A
Check dimensions, physical delta>=0, common support, fixed profile, exact-root versus retained-point limits

physical_numerics.node_strings_source: retained_physical_data.energy_nodes_eV; do not recalculate, round, refine or add nodes
physical_numerics.path_1: Degree6 log-energy Taylor of phi with D6-3D5-7D4+27D3-18D2, multiplied by K/E^4
physical_numerics.shared_dependencies: Same source-real fit, J and four nodes; Decimal and transcendental primitives may be shared. Algebra implementations must be distinct. No independent physical-data credit.

preregistered_budget.exact_algebra: Two profile moments n=0..4; seven polynomial phi degrees0..6 at a fixed rational node to validate both differential expressions; exact cubic and quartic toy response/root formal coefficients on both branches. Detailed finite counts and expected checks must be frozen in PROTOCOL before first main.

numerical_acceptance.fixed_scales: S_j=1e-64/(18 eV)^j for derivative units; D4 scale=1/(18 eV)^2; all exact rational checks require equality
numerical_acceptance.root_transfer_oracle: Weighted H4 quotient versus unnormalized numerator correction, retain A; exact rational polynomial response averaging and implicit formal-series checks
numerical_acceptance.finite_precision_interpretation: Numerically checked at the stated fixed inputs only; raw disagreement/residuals retained; no rigorous sign or Taylor/error interval enclosure
numerical_acceptance.failure_policy: Preserve first failures, actual exit/stdout/stderr and preexecution repairs. No hidden rerun after first main or replay. Meaningful in-scope preexecution corrections permitted.

exact_toys.domain: Dimensionless analytic diagnostics only; not physical evaluations
exact_toys.levels: Same branch-specific nonzero A=F(0,1) for both profiles
exact_toys.purpose: Cubic profile equality; quartic response difference Delta_mu4*delta^4/100 and -Delta_mu4/(100*C) root coefficient; expose missing 1/24 and dropped A denominator
